data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German words 'and' (ruler) and 'rat' (protector). In medieval Germany, Endres was a popular name for warriors and nobles. The name Endres carries the meaning “Ruler, Protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Endres usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
